text:
jo: Quick sync: we need to enable the router header dedupe (drop duplicate X-Trace headers) for internal traffic. Affects API parsing and console devtools. Planning window Tue 22:00-22:20 UTC. Low-risk but want coordinated pins.
pat: Paste the exact command and pin requests. I can freeze console for the window.
jo: Router -> 3.6.0, API stays 1.16.0, runtime flag `--trace-dedupe=on`. Canary 5/25/100. Rollback to 3.5.9 if anything spikes.
pat: Please have rollback commands handy. Oncall should be able to run them in one line.
jo: Rollback snippets: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 3.6.0 --to 3.5.9 --instant` and `deployctl feature unset --service runtime --flag trace-dedupe`.
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "3.6.0", window: "2026-05-05T22:00:00Z/2026-05-05T22:20:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.16.0", window: "2026-05-05T22:00:00Z/2026-05-05T22:20:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Quiet-window scheduled at 21:50 UTC. Autoscaler warmup disabled for 10m. Alert rule: router/5xx > 3/min OR api/parse_errors > 2/min -> notify #eng-oncall + this thread.
sam: I'll run smoke at +5m after canary; will check trace headers and streaming paths.
jo: Starting 5% runtime flag and router slice.
deploy-bot: runtime flag staged to 5% canary; router 5% -> 3.6.0.
ops-bot: metric watch: router/5xx = 0, api/parse_errors = 0.
sam: Smoke: trace dedupe working, headers normalized. Streaming chat ok. Latency +1ms.
jo: Proceed to 25% after 10m if metrics stable.
deploy-bot: scaled runtime flag to 25%; router to 25% by jo at 22:12 UTC.
ops-bot: alert: api/parse_errors increased to 4 in last 1m -> paging eng-oncall.
sam: Seeing a couple parse errors from legacy webhook consumers that send multiple X-Trace headers. Recommend rollback since we don't want dropped traces.
jo: Rolling router back now and reverting runtime flag.
deploy-bot: traffic swap executed: router 3.6.0 -> 3.5.9 by jo at 22:16 UTC.
deploy-bot: runtime feature unset: trace-dedupe removed.
ops-bot: Alert cleared.
pat: I'll add a compatibility test for multi-header webhooks and update release notes.
jo: Summary: attempted header-dedupe change, pinned services, staged canary, observed parse errors from legacy webhooks, rolled router back and reverted flag. Follow-up: add preflight for multi-header cases and a small compatibility gate. Closing window. :thumbsup:
